name: City of Heroes Rise
description: Situated in a valley surrounded by hills, Heroes Rise was established by the Resistance during the Kemet Invasion and originally named Wharfugee. Its strategic location, combined with ancient druidic magic, made it an ideal site for constructing a hidden village. Over weeks of work, the Resistance fortified the city, creating what now is a symbol of the courage and resilience that gave birth to the Republic. Now, Heroes Rise stands as the cherished historical jewel of the Republic, capturing the spark that defied both the Kemets and the Empire. The city draws young adventurers, housing a major branch of the Adventurer’s Guild. Many believe starting their adventurer’s career here brings good fortune, luring countless aspiring heroes. Notable residents include Avelum, Tanares’ mightiest archmage; Zalir, the Relic Hunters’ founder; Sara, the seer who owns Tanares most prestigious tavern; and Sir Erick, the noble paladin and current Lord Mayor of Heroes Rise. Together with other legends of the Kemet Invasion, they turn Heroes Rise into the city of living legends. Heroes Rise’s streets pulse with optimism. Crime and poverty are rare, and the community’s bond, forged during wartime, remains strong. However, the Cult of Shadow Wing seeks to destroy the city, recognizing its significance in the hearts and minds of people across Tanares. The Cult wants to make the city an example of what happens to the enemies of their dark lords. High Cardinal Taram and the Celestianist Church also consider the city crucial due to a secret prophecy about a child or group of children destined to shape the world of Tanares. Uncertain if the Ungods’ followers are aware of the prophecy, they keep it closely guarded. Both Razun and Taram stay vigilant to safeguard all children of the city, ensuring that the city orphanage provides exceptional care to every child.
